chunks: 1065 - Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from him that he said:
If a man is greeted while he is performing salat (prayer), he should reply to him quietly, as he said.

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man being addressed in the ruling
key_terms.خَفِيًّا: quietly or in a low voice

ai.seo_question: How should a person respond to salām while praying?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about returning a greeting during salat (prayer). It indicates that the person praying should respond quietly, preserving both the right of the greeting and the state of worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1065 - Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Imam (as) that He said:
"If someone greets a man while he is praying, he should respond to him quietly, as He (the greeter) said."
